title: org-config-mcp-catalog-v1
description: An org config whose MCP servers were added from the connector catalog (AM-C9, CONNECTORS-PLAN.md section 3.2), as pushed to the gateway: catalog_ref and url_variables on a server entry, and in and name on the pushed credential secret, one server per placement (header, query, url_variable). The shape is the OrgConfig definition of the admin contract; this file only points at it, so the two can never drift. Resolve the reference by registering ../agentcc-admin.schema.json under its $id. mcp.servers.<id>.credential.secret exists only in pushed payloads, never in a saved config.
